schema.name: run_id
schema.description: One simulation run; four probes belong to the same run

schema.name: scenario
schema.description: Shared demand and seed input configuration

schema.name: probe_id
schema.description: Tracked vehicle identifier

schema.name: method
schema.description: Controller, not a learned feature

schema.name: is_reference
schema.description: True for the extra shared fixed-time baseline

schema.name: backend
schema.description: Simulator API/backend

schema.name: engine_version
schema.description: Actual simulator version reported by the running backend

schema.name: simulation_step_s
schema.description: Numerical simulation step length in seconds

schema.name: stop_reason
schema.description: All tracked probes arrived, or simulation guard reached

schema.name: phase_switches
schema.description: Controller switches across the network up to stop; unequal windows

schema.name: controller_exercised
schema.description: False for QD runs that only used the initial/fallback plan

schema.name: demand_scale
schema.description: Demand multiplier; assumed, not observed traffic

schema.name: seed
schema.description: Paired random seed; not a traffic measurement

schema.name: vehicle_type
schema.description: Probe class

schema.name: vehicle_movement_model
schema.description: Recorded movement model; unspecified for legacy runs

schema.name: lane_change_model
schema.description: Recorded SUMO lane-changing model

schema.name: route_variant
schema.description: Fixed center/outer probe path

schema.name: corridor_vph_per_direction
schema.description: Explicitly assigned corridor background vehicles/hour/direction

schema.name: corridor_requested_vph_forward
schema.description: Explicitly assigned corridor background vehicles/hour towards Truong Chinh

schema.name: corridor_requested_vph_reverse
schema.description: Explicitly assigned corridor background vehicles/hour in the opposite direction

schema.name: map_requested_vph
schema.description: Requested background vehicles/hour, whole map

schema.name: corridor_related_requested_vph
schema.description: Requested journeys/hour using any Cong Hoa segment; includes side-road entry and exit journeys

schema.name: corridor_related_generated_vehicles
schema.description: Generated ordinary journeys using any Cong Hoa segment during the demand window

schema.name: map_generated_vehicles
schema.description: Generated background vehicles during demand window; not actually inserted

schema.name: map_generation_ratio
schema.description: Generated / requested background vehicles during demand window; routing losses, not completion rate

schema.name: demand_duration_s
schema.description: Demand generation window (s)

schema.name: probe_requested_depart_s
schema.description: Scheduled probe departure (s)

schema.name: motorcycle_share
schema.description: Requested corridor motorcycle proportion

schema.name: car_share
schema.description: Requested corridor passenger-car proportion

schema.name: truck_share
schema.description: Requested corridor truck proportion

schema.name: bus_share
schema.description: Requested corridor bus proportion

schema.name: travel_time_s
schema.description: Actual insertion to arrival; excludes departure delay

schema.name: waiting_time_s
schema.description: Waiting within trip, already part of travel time

schema.name: depart_delay_s
schema.description: Delay before insertion; separate from travel time

schema.name: route_length_m
schema.description: Distance actually traveled from SUMO tripinfo (m)

schema.name: mean_speed_kmh
schema.description: Actual route length / trip duration × 3.6

schema.name: time_loss_s
schema.description: SUMO timeLoss, not equal to waitingTime

schema.name: waiting_count
schema.description: SUMO waitingCount

schema.name: collisions
schema.description: Whole-run collision count up to stop

schema.name: teleports
schema.description: Whole-run teleport count up to stop

schema.name: completed
schema.description: Probe arrival recorded

schema.name: censored
schema.description: Probe has no recorded arrival at experiment stop

schema.name: departed
schema.description: Probe was actually inserted into the network

schema.name: valid_for_comparison
schema.description: Eligibility under the saved comparison policy; all_four_arrived permits runs with flagged events

schema.name: clean_run
schema.description: Original strict check including zero whole-run collisions and teleports

schema.name: all_four_arrived
schema.description: All four distinct tracked vehicles recorded positive completed trip durations

schema.name: probe_teleported
schema.description: Tracked vehicle named in a teleport warning; blank if simulator log is unavailable

schema.name: probe_collision
schema.description: Tracked vehicle named in a collision warning; blank if simulator log is unavailable

schema.name: paired_valid
schema.description: Valid probe and fixed-time reference with matching input hashes

schema.name: improvement_vs_fixed_percent
schema.description: Paired travel-time reduction; positive is faster

schema.name: network_sha256
schema.description: Network content version

schema.name: input_sha256
schema.description: Canonical digest of all frozen simulation input hashes

schema.name: actual_end_s
schema.description: Actual observation horizon for this method

schema.name: inserted_network_vehicles
schema.description: Vehicles actually inserted by run stop

schema.name: mean_network_speed_mps
schema.description: Network snapshot speed at stop; observation horizons may differ

schema.name: halted_network_vehicles
schema.description: Vehicles halting at experiment stop

schema.name: arrived_network_vehicles
schema.description: Vehicles arrived by run stop; windows differ, do not rank raw totals

schema.name: running_network_vehicles
schema.description: Vehicles still running when experiment stops

schema.name: pending_network_vehicles
schema.description: Vehicles awaiting insertion when experiment stops

notes: Comparison policy: all_four_arrived. Quality flags remain recorded independently.
Demand levels are estimated reference inputs.
Runs stop when the tracked vehicles arrive or the time limit is reached.
Four tracked vehicles in one run share the same random seed.
Travel time starts at actual network insertion and excludes departure delay.
Each result records its signal transition policy.
